fra.text: Hexhaven Academy is the Echoverse's regimented battlemage school, founded by sphinxes atop the leyline confluence from which they emerged, and in Reality Fracture it becomes the heart of Jace's plan, serving as the inner sanctum that stabilizes the Echoverse.
The Theorist, the worst part of Jace, takes up residence in the central bell tower, which transforms to fulfill its true purpose as the Echoverse Fulcrum meant to merge the Multiverses.
Tam returns to Hexhaven with the captured oracle Jadzi feeling empty rather than victorious, and she comes to resolve to betray the worst part of her maker in honor of the best parts.

When Hexhaven merges into Strixhaven, Tam receives Jace's spark and asks Emrakul to feast on the false Multiverse, then she becomes real for the first time and planeswalks home as Hexhaven is marked separate from Strixhaven and drawn into the sky.
